title: Recording: Mamunia, Mrs Vandebilt by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio One, AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The final recording session for Wings’ Band On The Run album took place on 19 October 1973.

The last two songs requiring overdubs were ‘Mamunia’ and ‘Mrs Vandebilt’. Band On The Run was mixed from 25-28 October 1973.

There was one final overdub, to ‘Nineteen Hundred And Eighty Five’, recorded on 28 October during a mixing session, but this was the last full and dedicated recording session for the album.
